dataset_status: VCTK follow-up on previously studied identities; not independent validation
feature_representation: frozen pre_encoder mean with Task 09B training-speaker-only per-dimension z-score and cosine matching
limitations: RMS normalization changes waveform amplitude only; it does not equalize microphone frequency response and the gain cap leaves some low-level clips below target

normalized_threshold_calibration.policy: single global threshold fitted on leave-one-identity-out maximum impostor scores; reused for every evaluation registry and duration
normalized_threshold_calibration.uncertainty_note: calibration speaker population is only 15 identities per fold; pair/query counts are correlated within speaker

protocol.query_clips_per_speaker: up to four; each original mic1/mic2 source utterance remains paired
protocol.raw_comparison: same frozen z-score representation and same speaker/microphone protocol on original PCM16 audio; audio variant selected without evaluation outcomes
protocol.threshold: per fold and mic condition, calibrated only on calibration speakers; separate frozen mic1-calibration transfer rows are also reported

score_shift_summary: raw and normalized condition score quantiles are included per fold; repeated mic renderings are clustered by source utterance and speaker
